901-the-jew-of-malta.title: The Jew Of Malta
901-the-jew-of-malta.creator: Christopher Marlowe
901-the-jew-of-malta.description: A book by Christopher Marlowe. We pursue  The story of a rich and famous Jew  Who liv'd in Malta:  you shall find him still,  In all his projects, a sound Machiavill;  And that's his character. He that hath past  So many censures [3] is now come at last  To have your princely ears:  grace you him; then  You crown the action, and renown the pen.

arxiv-2208-06276.title: Sequential Causal Imitation Learning with Unobserved Confounders
arxiv-2208-06276.creator: Daniel Kumor, Junzhe Zhang, Elias Bareinboim
arxiv-2208-06276.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Daniel Kumor, Junzhe Zhang, Elias Bareinboim. “Monkey see monkey do" is an age-old adage, referring to naïve imitation without a deep understanding of a system’s underlying mechanics. Indeed, if a demonstrator has access to information unavailable to the imitator (monkey), such as a different set of sensors, then no matter how perfectly the imitator models its perceived environment ( See ), attempting to reproduce the demonstrator’s behavior ( Do ) can lead to poor outcomes.

arxiv-2209-08143.title: Enhancing quality and speed in database-free neural network reconstructions of undersampled MRI with SCAMPI
arxiv-2209-08143.creator: Thomas M. Siedler, Peter M. Jakob, Volker Herold
arxiv-2209-08143.description: Abstract Purpose: We present SCAMPI (Sparsity Constrained Application of deep Magnetic resonance Priors for Image reconstruction), an untrained deep Neural Network for MRI reconstruction without previous training on datasets. It expands the Deep Image Prior approach with a multi-domain, sparsity-enforcing loss function to achieve higher image quality at a faster convergence speed than previously reported methods.

arxiv-2305-19632.title: Generalized Veto Core and a Practical Voting Rule with Optimal Metric Distortion CCS: Applied computing Economics CCS: Applied computing Voting / election technologies
arxiv-2305-19632.creator: Fatih Erdem Kizilkaya, David Kempe
arxiv-2305-19632.description: Abstract . We revisit the recent breakthrough result of Gkatzelis et al. on (single-winner) metric voting, which showed that the optimal distortion of 3 can be achieved by a mechanism called PluralityMatching . The rule picks an arbitrary candidate for whom a certain candidate-specific bipartite graph contains a perfect matching.

arxiv-2306-15415.title: Quantum Fourier Networks for Solving Parametric PDEs
arxiv-2306-15415.creator: Nishant Jain, Jonas Landman, Natansh Mathur, Iordanis Kerenidis
arxiv-2306-15415.description: Abstract Many real-world problems, like modelling environment dynamics, physical processes, time series etc., involve solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) parameterised by problem-specific conditions. Recently, a deep learning architecture called Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) proved to be capable of learning solutions of given PDE families for any initial conditions as input.

arxiv-2401-06222.title: Engineering One Axis Twisting via a Dissipative Berry Phase Using Strong Symmetries
arxiv-2401-06222.creator: Jeremy T. Young, Edwin Chaparro, Asier Piñeiro Orioli, James K. Thompson, Ana Maria Rey
arxiv-2401-06222.description: Abstract We show how a driven-dissipative cavity coupled to a collective ensemble of atoms can dynamically generate metrologically useful spin-squeezed states. In contrast to other dissipative approaches, we do not rely on complex engineered dissipation or input states, nor do we require tuning the system to a critical point.

arxiv-2504-04325.title: Construyendo la verdad: minería de texto y redes lingüísticas en audiencias públicas del Caso 03 de la Jurisdicción Especial para la Paz (JEP)
arxiv-2504-04325.creator: Juan Sosa, Alejandro Urrego-López, Cesar Prieto, Emma J. Camargo-Díaz
arxiv-2504-04325.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Juan Sosa, Alejandro Urrego-López, Cesar Prieto, Emma J. Camargo-Díaz. El Caso 03 de la Jurisdicción Especial para la Paz (JEP), centrado en los denominados falsos positivos en Colombia, constituye uno de los episodios más desgarradores del conflicto armado colombiano. Este artículo propone una metodología innovadora basada en el análisis de lenguaje natural y modelos de co-ocurrencia semántica para explorar, sistematizar y visualizar patrones narrativos presentes en las audiencias públicas de víctimas y comparecientes.

pmc-10515509.title: Whole Exome Sequencing Achieved a Definite Diagnosis of Kaufman Oculocerebrofacial Syndrome in a Bahraini Family: A Case Report
pmc-10515509.creator: Mariam Fida, Israa Sinan, Alan Finan
pmc-10515509.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). A 1 year and 7 months old girl presented to the medical genetic clinic as a referral from the pediatrics clinic. Upon examining the patient and assessing past medical history, an autosomal recessive disorder was suspected. The family underwent whole exome sequencing, which resulted in the diagnosis of Kaufman oculocerebrofacial syndrome (OMIM #244450) in the patient due to the fact that both parents were heterozygous carriers of a novel pathogenic variant in the gene UBE3B that lies on 12q24.

pmc-11283443.title: Uterine artery embolisation for adenomyosis in women who failed prior endometrial ablation
pmc-11283443.creator: Eisen Liang, Razeen Parvez, Sylvia Ng, Bevan Brown
pmc-11283443.description: –20% of women require additional intervention (re-ablation or hysterectomy) due to persistent bleeding or pain [1]. Women with adenomyosis are more likely to fail EA [2]. Those with unsatisfactory outcomes from EA may be offered hysterectomy as their only remaining treatment option. Case series and meta-analyses have demonstrated that UAE is effective in alleviating adenomyosis-related HMB and dysmenorrhea [3, 4].

pmc-11621599.title: Chinese expert consensus on the diagnosis and clinical management of medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw
pmc-11621599.creator: Han-Jin Ruan, Heng Chen, Jin-Song Hou, Jin-Gang An, Yu-Xing Guo, Bing Liu, Lei Tian, Jian Pan, Jin-Song Li, Can-Hua Jiang, Zhen Tian, Jie Xu, Ling Zhu, Chang-Fu Sun, Ke-Qian Zhi, Qing Qu, Chun-Lin Zong, Meng-Yu Li, Zhi-Yuan Zhang, Yue He
pmc-11621599.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Graphical abstract Introduction With advancement in cancer treatment, the survival rate of cancer patients has improved significantly [1], [2]. The skeleton is a common site for metastases from several solid tumors, notably breast, lung and prostate cancers. Patients with bone metastasis often experience reduced survival rates, impaired quality of life and increased risk of skeletal related events (SREs), including pathological fractures [3].

pmc-12563689.title: Automatic Detection and Proximity Quantification of Inferior Alveolar Nerve and Mandibular Third Molar on CBCT: A Systematic Review
pmc-12563689.creator: Abdullah R. F. Alanazi, Saud A. T. Alshammari, Salman A. S. Aljudaya, Dari A. S. Alshammri, Faisal M. S. Alazmi, Namdeo Prabhu
pmc-12563689.description: The present systematic review aimed to investigate AI-based automated identification and proximity quantification of the inferior alveolar nerve (IAN) and the mandibular third molar (M3) on CBCT images. Precise localization of the IAN is important in the surgical removal of mandibular third molars to avoid nerve injuries, resulting in sensory disturbances.

pmc-12932809.title: Role of friction on the formation of confined granular structures
pmc-12932809.creator: Vinícius P. S. Oliveira, Danilo S. Borges, Erick M. Franklin, Jorge Peixinho
pmc-12932809.description: Metastable fluidized granular systems can spontaneously defluidize, forming glass- or crystal-like structures. We performed experiments with polymer spheres of different friction and roughness fluidized in a vertical water pipe flow. Velocity fluctuations were higher for high friction materials. Monodisperse particles form a crystal-like shell on the cylinder wall for a range of flow rates and number of particles.

pmc-13630854.description: Beta amyloid diffuse plaques, neurofibrillary tangles and neuritic plaques, are increased in densities at the intermediate stage of Alzheimer's neuropathological change.
